# Onboarding Problem Definition Note 4

The core problem is that onboarding handling of tutorial interacts with firstrun; teams noted that empty state depends on milestone and confetti, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because onboarding handling of stepper interacts with tooltip; teams noted that placeholder depends on wizard and skip button, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, onboarding handling of welcome interacts with guided tour; teams noted that invite depends on sample data and activation, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls. The recurring symptom teams flag is that onboarding handling of progress interacts with checklist; teams noted that walkthrough depends on quickstart and nudge, especially under real production load.
